interface.signature: canMeasureWater(x: int, y: int, z: int) -> bool

preconditions.description: All jug capacities and target volume must be non-negative integers.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (z == 0 or (z <= x + y and z % math.gcd(x, y) == 0))
postconditions.description: The function returns True if and only if z is zero or z is a non-negative integer less than or equal to the sum of the jug capacities and a multiple of the greatest common divisor (GCD) of x and y.

interface.signature: canMeasureWater(x: int, y: int, z: int) -> bool

preconditions.description: All jug capacities and target volume must be non-negative integers.
The target volume z must not exceed the combined capacity of the two jugs.
